data.text:
🛑 KLEPTOPIROSIS: The Disease Marcos Refuses to Cure
By Dr. Tony Leachon | August 22, 2025

The floods have returned.
Not with fury from the skies, but with silence from Malacañang.

Metro Manila is submerged again.
Children wade through sewage.
Hospitals overflow—not with patients, but with floodwater.
And the President watches.
He names contractors. He orders probes.
But he does not act.

This is not just a failure of infrastructure.
This is a failure of leadership.

We are not drowning in rain.
We are drowning in betrayal.

For years, billions have been poured into flood control programs.
And yet, the waters rise.
Why?
Because the money flowed into pockets—not pipelines.
Into ghost projects—not gutters.
Into kickbacks—not communities.

This is the birth of a new epidemic:
KLEPTOPIROSIS—a grotesque fusion of kleptocracy and leptospirosis.
It is the disease of stolen futures.
It infects our streets, our homes, our hopes.

President Marcos Jr. has the power to stop this.
He has the names.
He has the data.
He has the mandate.
But he lacks the will.

What good is a probe without prosecution?
What good is a hearing without healing?
What good is a leader who watches his people drown?

We demand more than words.
We demand:

• ⚖️ Criminal charges against corrupt officials and contractors
• 📢 Full transparency of all flood control projects
• 🛑 Immediate suspension of questionable contracts
• 💧 Emergency health response to leptospirosis outbreaks

This is not a request.
This is a reckoning.

Every flood is a verdict.
Every infection is a protest.
Every submerged barangay is a scream.

Mr. President, the country is not asking for miracles.
We are asking for justice.
For clean water.
For honest governance.
For a future where rain does not mean ruin.

Until then, we will name the disease.
We will name the culprits.
And we will never stop fighting.

#KleptopirosisIsReal
#RelentlessForChange
#MahiyaNamanKayo
#HealthWithHonor

Tony Leachon
@iampinglacson 
@usapinglacson

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Depression ISANG
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 22 August 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna and Quezon within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Tarlac, Nueva Ecija and Pampanga which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
